mostWorthwhile.text: Filling the troughs with granules was most worthwhile because it explained how gaps and drainage keep air around roots.

leastWorthwhile.text: Mixing the nutrient solution repeated the distinction between root support and nourishment that the bench had already explained.

surprise.text: I was interested that the crushed ceramic needed a leach check before it could safely go near roots.

arbitrary.text: No chosen action felt arbitrary; each had a clear role in preparing or supplying the beds.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the lettuce and potatoes grow and what happens next, especially after building separate beds for them.
